pages.title: Giant Tapir
pages.text: The giant tapir ($(o)Megatapirus augustus$()) is an extinct tapir that lived in southern China and Southeast Asia during the Pleistocene.$(br2)It was considerably larger than any living tapir, though it shared their general build and short prehensile snout.$(br2)Like modern tapirs, it lived in forests and fed on leaves and other plant matter.
